materialFindings.detail: Two facts use sync and one help. Family and ARTICLE_FAMILIES support weather/unify/widgets/sharing/planning/compare only. Static English hub/topic filtering omits these pages and TypeScript should reject the invalid values.
materialFindings.recommendedFix: Use planning for both scheduling pages and unify for time-zone-rule troubleshooting; regenerate/rebuild as root owns integration.
